You see the kind of pick like the Titans made at 4 all the time...in fantasy drafts when a GM panics



— https://nitter.net/ToddFuhrman/status/2047475065181307229#m

Titans have had one legit true number one receiver in almost thirty years — AJ Brown — & they traded him for Treylon Burks. Now we drafted a guy who has gotten one on one coverage his entire career and isn’t even the best receiver on his college team number four overall. Insane.

Carnell Tate at four is absurdly bad. I hate the Titans drafts every year. Trade back! He’s not even a top WR at Ohio State. And I don’t even think he’s the best receiver in the draft!

Video
Every year the guy I want the Titans to take gets taken the pick before them. It’s uncanny.

I’ve rooted for QBs with worse arms!

This isn’t “sexism” by the way. If a male reporter for a women’s sports league was sleeping with a coach the same rules would apply. This also only is about their jobs, this is a mess for both in their private lives.

Two things: 1. Mike Vrabel’s job shouldn’t be in remote jeopardy over this. 2. Dianna Russini can no longer work as a “reporter.” She can do sports media, but it will 100% have to be as an opinion person. She may, or may not, be good at that. I have no idea.
